title: Sanlam Cape Town Marathon — Road Closures and Parking Restrictions (2024 edition page)
claims: The 2024 Sanlam Cape Town Marathon took place over the weekend of 19 and 20 October 2024.
The page describes the event at that time as being in its assessment year as a candidate to become an Abbott World Marathon Majors event.
The page publishes area-specific road closures and parking restrictions for Atlantic Seaboard, CBD, Salt River and Southern Suburbs.
